caseName: Planned Parenthood of Central Missouri v. Danforth
caseNameFull: Planned Parenthood of Central Missouri v. Danforth, Attorney General of Missouri

opinions.text:
D. C. E. D. Mo. Application for stay of enforcement of “Missouri House Bill No. 1211” pending appeal, presented to Mr. Justice Blackmun, and by him referred to the Court, granted.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.*
